content.json:
# 🔐 BitLocker Extension Attribute — Operations Overview

Monitoraggio visuale di **__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__**. La dashboard evidenzia affidabilità, volume di sincronizzazione, copertura, conflitti e anomalie del mapping `__EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME__`.

## Stato corrente
I KPI derivano dall'ultimo ciclo disponibile e dai job compresi nell'intervallo selezionato.

content.query:
let Cycles = AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_CYCLE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription));
let Latest = Cycles
| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc
| project Valutati = tolong(Payload.evaluated), Aggiornati = tolong(Payload.updated), Errori = tolong(Payload.errors), Saltati = tolong(Payload.skipped), Interrotto = tobool(Payload.aborted), NonRisolti = tolong(Payload.unresolved), StatoIgnoto = tolong(Payload.unknownEncryptionState), Compliant = tolong(Payload.compliant), UltimoCiclo = TimeGenerated;
let Jobs = AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| summarize Completati = countif(ResultType == "Completed"), Falliti = countif(ResultType in ("Failed", "Suspended", "Stopped"));
let Conflicts = AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_CONFLICT]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| summarize Conflitti = sum(tolong(Payload.conflicts));
union
(Latest | project Ordine = 1, KPI = "Device valutati", Valore = Valutati, Dettaglio = strcat("Ultimo ciclo: ", format_datetime(UltimoCiclo, "dd/MM HH:mm"))),
(Latest | project Ordine = 2, KPI = "Aggiornati", Valore = Aggiornati, Dettaglio = "Modifiche applicate"),
(Latest | project Ordine = 3, KPI = "Già conformi", Valore = Compliant, Dettaglio = "Nessun update richiesto"),
(Conflicts | project Ordine = 4, KPI = "Conflitti", Valore = Conflitti, Dettaglio = "Nel periodo selezionato"),
(Latest | project Ordine = 5, KPI = "Errori", Valore = Errori, Dettaglio = iff(Interrotto, "Ciclo interrotto", "Errori ultimo ciclo")),
(Latest | project Ordine = 6, KPI = "Saltati", Valore = Saltati, Dettaglio = "Non elaborati per arresto sicuro"),
(Latest | project Ordine = 7, KPI = "Non risolti", Valore = NonRisolti, Dettaglio = "Device senza match Entra"),
(Jobs | project Ordine = 8, KPI = "Job completati", Valore = Completati, Dettaglio = "Nel periodo selezionato"),
(Jobs | project Ordine = 9, KPI = "Job falliti", Valore = Falliti, Dettaglio = "Failed, Suspended o Stopped")
| order by Ordine asc
content.title: KPI operativi

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_CYCLE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| where coalesce(tobool(Payload.aborted), false) == false
| project TimeGenerated, Valutati = tolong(Payload.evaluated), Compliant = tolong(Payload.compliant), Richiesti = tolong(Payload.requested), Aggiornati = tolong(Payload.updated)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: 📈 Volume e risultato per ciclo

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Suspended", "Stopped")
| summarize Job = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Esito = ResultType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| render columnchart
content.title: 📊 Affidabilità giornaliera dei job

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_UPDATE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend ValoreRaw = tostring(Payload.value)
| extend Valore = iff(isempty(ValoreRaw), "(azzerato)", ValoreRaw)
| summarize Aggiornamenti = count() by Valore
| render piechart
content.title: 🍩 Aggiornamenti per valore destinazione

content.query:
let CycleAnomalies = AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_CYCLE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| project TimeGenerated, Conflitti = long(0), Errori = tolong(Payload.errors), Saltati = tolong(Payload.skipped), Interrotti = iff(tobool(Payload.aborted), long(1), long(0)), NonRisolti = tolong(Payload.unresolved), StatoIgnoto = tolong(Payload.unknownEncryptionState);
let ConflictAnomalies = AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_CONFLICT]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| project TimeGenerated, Conflitti = tolong(Payload.conflicts), Errori = long(0), Saltati = long(0), Interrotti = long(0), NonRisolti = tolong(Payload.unresolved), StatoIgnoto = tolong(Payload.unknownEncryptionState);
union CycleAnomalies, ConflictAnomalies
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| render columnchart
content.title: ⚠️ Anomalie per ciclo

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_UPDATE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend Device = tostring(Payload.deviceName), Valore = tostring(Payload.value)
| where isnotempty(Device)
| summarize Aggiornamenti = count() by Device, Valore
| top 15 by Aggiornamenti desc
| render barchart
content.title: 🖥️ Device aggiornati più frequentemente

content.json:
## Diagnostica
Le tabelle sono mantenute in fondo alla dashboard per il drill-down operativo.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where StreamType_s == "Error" or ResultDescription contains "[ERROR]"
| project TimeGenerated, Tipo = StreamType_s, Dettaglio = ResultDescription, JobId = JobId_g
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: 🚨 Errori e conflitti recenti

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__EXTENSION_RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[EXTENSION_ATTRIBUTE_UPDATE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| project TimeGenerated, Device = tostring(Payload.deviceName), ValorePrecedente = tostring(Payload.previousValue), NuovoValore = tostring(Payload.value), Attributo = tostring(Payload.attribute), ObjectId = tostring(Payload.objectId), JobId = JobId_g
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: 🔎 Ultimi aggiornamenti applicati
